events.name: Chamoli Flash Flood & River Blockage Event
events.trigger: Rock and hanging glacier avalanche on Ronti peak causing downstream river blockage and catastrophic surge wave
sensors_available: Sentinel-1 SAR C-band (pre and post event passes)
events.validation_use: Benchmark dataset for SPH wave impact and Delft3D steep-canyon flood wave arrival times

events.name: Tehri Reservoir Extreme Inflow Event
events.trigger: Monsoon high-intensity cloudburst in upper Bhagirathi catchment
events.validation_use: Boundary inflow hydrograph calibration for normal and extreme spillway release scenarios
